title: Build and iterate a PageRank transition matrix
description: You turn link rows into probabilities and iterate a distribution toward a stationary result.

steps.description: You store directed links in A and find rows whose sums are zero. Replacing those rows with ones prepares dangling pages for uniform outgoing probabilities.
You normalize rows into P and mix them with uniform teleportation. G is the resulting PageRank transition matrix.

steps.question: What comparison lets power iteration return before max_iter?
steps.answer: It compares the L1 norm of pi_new minus pi with tol. That norm sums the absolute component changes.

steps.description: You repeatedly multiply pi by G, then print the matrix, page scores, and distribution sum. The recording assigns Page 2 the largest score.
